historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_3yr_cagr (12.5%, FY2022-FY2025) tempered to the H1 FY2026 run-rate (+11.4%) and softer H2 consumption; equity CAGR is unusable as a growth anchor (negative pre-IPO equity in FY2022 from redeemable preferred shares, then shrunk by buybacks), and EPS is unusable (FY2022 loss, FY2023 IPO revaluation gain).
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity and EPS CAGRs cannot be computed on a clean basis: FY2022 equity was RMB -18.96bn (preferred shares classified as liabilities) and FY2023 EPS embeds a RMB6.5bn non-cash gain. Revenue is the only clean 3-year series.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF (reported FCF - SBC - interest income): FY2022 -934, FY2023 329, FY2024 672, FY2025 293 (RMB m). The 2-year owner-FCF CAGR (-5.7%) is materially below the reported-FCF CAGR (+6.6%): SBC doubled in FY2025 (142 -> 281m) and interest income on the growing treasury pile rose, so an increasing share of reported FCF growth is being paid for in stock and earned on cash rather than operations. H1 FY2026 owner FCF was negative (-190m) on seasonal working capital and the margin squeeze.

scenario_narratives.base: Tuhu keeps taking share in a consolidating but price-competitive independent aftermarket: workshop count grows low-double digits for two more years then slows, revenue decelerates from 10.5% to 3.5%, and the H1 FY2026 margin trough (adjusted EBITDA 3.7%) is repaired gradually -- back to the FY2023-24 level of ~5% by FY2030 and 5.5% at maturity -- through store maturation, higher-margin franchise and advertising fees and procurement scale, with management's 'gradual restoration' repeatedly diluted by price concessions. The pre-IPO tax-loss shelter rolls off and cash tax climbs to 18%. The equity is roughly half net cash and half a thin-margin but cash-generative operating business.
scenario_narratives.bull: Industry consolidation accelerates under explicit PRC policy support for scaled chains; NEV out-of-warranty servicing, lower-tier city expansion and Qipeilong keep growth at 10-12% through FY2029. The price war with JD Auto Care eases as JD's auto-care push matures, mix shifts to platform fees, and AI shopping guides / warehouse automation deliver the operating leverage the model has promised: adjusted EBITDA margin reaches 7.0%, about 1.4pp above the FY2023 peak. Buybacks continue to retire ~4% of shares a year at depressed prices (value-neutral in the model, but accretive in practice if the IV is right).
scenario_narratives.bear: The business is a low-margin logistics/marketplace operator with no pricing power: JD Auto Care, Tmall and Meituan keep undercutting, Chinese consumers keep trading down, oil-linked input costs stay volatile, and the H1 FY2026 margin (3.5-3.7%) is the new normal rather than a trough. Growth fades to GDP-like 2.5% as store additions slow and lower-tier stores underperform. Operating FCF covers little more than SBC and leases, so the equity is worth roughly its net cash plus a modest operating stub -- which is about where the market prices it today. Capital-allocation risk (WVR control, the A$403m mycar acquisition) sits on top of this case.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the operating business on owner FCF built from components (adjusted EBITDA less SBC, lease cash, D&A, a ramping cash tax, capex and a growth-linked supplier-float inflow) in RMB at a CNY-built 9.5% WACC, add the surplus cash and treasury investments that earn the stripped finance income, and translate per-share values to HKD at the dated spot rate. The FY2023 net income spike is an IPO accounting artefact and plays no role. Most of the valuation debate is about whether the margin trough is cyclical (base/bull) or structural (bear); the net-cash leg (~HK$9.7/share) is the same in every scenario, which is why the bear case lands near the current price.
key_risks_to_valuation: Margin path: every 1pp of mature adjusted EBITDA margin is worth roughly HK$3-4/share; the base assumes a recovery that has not yet started (H1 FY2026 adjusted EBITDA margin 3.7% vs 6.1% a year earlier).

Net cash is ~84% of the market capitalisation; the bridge assumes RMB6.46bn of cash and treasury investments is surplus and accessible. Dividends have never been paid, and ~RMB1.9bn is earmarked for the mycar (Australia) acquisition -- a value-destructive deal would take up to ~HK$2.9/share off the net-cash leg.

Supplier float: trade and bills payables (RMB4.9bn) fund the balance sheet; if growth stalls or suppliers tighten terms, the working-capital inflow in the model reverses and part of the cash pile is effectively owed to suppliers.

Cash tax: the model assumes 18-20% at maturity, not the 25% statutory rate, on the strength of the R&D super-deduction and HNTE rates; loss of HNTE status or a smaller R&D deduction would cost ~HK$1/share.
Currency: IV is computed in CNY and quoted in HKD at 1.1749; a 5% CNY depreciation against the HKD peg moves every HKD figure by 5%.
Governance: founder controls ~48% of votes via 10-vote Class B shares on a much smaller economic stake; buybacks have so far been the main form of capital return.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (HKEX regular close); 52-week range HK$10.00-18.89.
data_sources.fx: Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X at the date in inputs.fx_note, cross-checked against USDHKD=X and USDCNY=X.
data_sources.financials: 9690.HK_Metrics.csv / core_metrics and kpis (FY2022-H1 FY2026, RMB millions); FY2025 annual report (adjusted EBITDA reconciliation line 1326, cash flow statement lines 5373-5462, income tax note lines 7620-7660); H1 FY2026 interim report (balance sheet lines 2330-2404, cash flow lines 2555-2642, diluted EPS note line 3031-3039, share capital and treasury shares note lines 3146-3215).
data_sources.qualitative: 9690.HK_Analysis.json (qualitative-analyst, 2026-10-24): business model, competitive position, price-competition and consumption risks, guidance commentary, bull/bear points.

inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted at 30 June 2026: 827,690,689 shares in issue (note 15) less 68,641k treasury shares = 759.05m outstanding, plus 20.36m dilutive options/RSUs (H1 FY2026 diluted EPS note) = 779.4m. Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows; charging dilution as well would double-count. Buybacks (RMB575m FY2025, RMB486m H1 FY2026) are the cash mechanism that keeps the count flat and are value-neutral here.
inputs.cash_composition_note: 30 June 2026 balance sheet: cash and cash equivalents 1,511.9 + short-term treasury investments 2,650.4 + long-term treasury investments 2,295.5 = 6,457.8. Restricted cash (1,104.3 current + 88.4 non-current) is EXCLUDED: it collateralises bank acceptance bills inside trade and bills payables and is operating, not surplus. Lease liabilities (252.8) excluded from net debt under lease treatment (B). Debt is RMB1.8m of unsecured bank loans. NCI is RMB -2.6m (negative, immaterial, ignored).
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report, adjusted EBITDA reconciliation 'Share-based payment expenses' RMB280,719k (9690.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt:1326); equity-award cash taxes nil (awards settled from treasury shares, no net-share-settlement tax line). H1 FY2026 SBC RMB55.9m; TTM 232.7m = 1.34% of revenue.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows in RMB (filing headers 'RMB'000'); HKEX quote in HKD. fx_rate is HKD per CNY (model -> quote): CNYHKD=X 1.1749, Yahoo Finance, 2026-10-23. No dual listing exists for a parity check; direction verified against the USD legs (USDHKD / USDCNY) at the same date. All per-share values are computed in CNY and multiplied by fx_rate; unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are HKD so they compare to current_price. refresh_price.py moves the price but not this rate; re-derive it on any later refresh.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY, the currency of the flows: 10y China government bond ~1.8%, China ERP ~6.5% (mature-market 4.3% plus country risk), beta 1.15-1.2 for a thin-margin consumer platform exposed to discretionary spend and price competition -> cost of equity 9.3-10.2%; no debt, so WACC = cost of equity. Set at 10.0% (the upper end of that range: ERP 7% x beta 1.2 + 1.8%) after the first build at 9.5% tripped the multiples sanity check (implied SBC-adjusted P/E vs history); this is the one fix pass applied, chosen from the same CNY inputs rather than an ad-hoc premium. Same WACC in all three scenarios: price-war, consumption and execution risk are charged in the flows and the weights, not stacked on the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost. Full lease cash (FY2025 principal 132.8 + interest 11.8 = 144.6m, 0.88% of revenue; H1 FY2026 64.2m, 0.73%) is charged inside EBIT via lease_cost_pct_path at 0.8%. Lease liabilities (RMB252.8m) are excluded from net debt. D&A for the tax line is ex right-of-use depreciation: FY2025 304.2 - 123.9 ROU = 180.3m = 1.10% of revenue (H1 FY2026 158.2 - 62.2 = 96.0m, 1.09%). Note last_fcf follows the contract formula (reported - SBC - interest) and does not yet deduct the lease cash; the forward build does, so FY0 owner FCF on the same basis as the projections is ~148m.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI RMB -2.6m at 30 June 2026 and NCI share of profit <RMB1m; no adjustment.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF, 10-year explicit horizon (FY2026-FY2035) because margins are at a cyclical/competitive trough and the year-5 owner-FCF margin is still ramping. Routed via dcf-methods: operating company (O2O auto-service marketplace + parts distribution), non-US, dual currency, material leases and a large net-cash pile, so owner-fcf.md plus the adaptations file apply. EARNINGS BASE: FY2023 net income (RMB6,700.7m) is dominated by a RMB6,465m non-cash fair-value gain on convertible preferred shares at IPO and is NOT used anywhere; the base is adjusted EBITDA (post-IFRS 16, pre-SBC; company definition excludes tax, finance income/costs, D&A and SBC): FY2023 5.6%, FY2024 5.3%, FY2025 5.1%, H1 FY2026 3.7%, TTM ~4.0%. INTEREST INCOME: net cash (6.46bn) is >20x the owner-FCF base, so finance income (175.9m FY2025) is stripped and every treasury investment that earns it sits in the bridge (matching-asset rule). CASH TAX: FY2025 effective rate 0.7% (cash paid 3.8m) because of R&D super-deduction (74.6m), 15% HNTE rate on some subsidiaries and utilisation of pre-IPO tax losses; the NOL shelter is finite (PRC 5-year carryforward), so the cash rate ramps from 6% to 18% by FY2032 (bear 20%), below the 25% statutory to reflect the durable R&D deduction and HNTE rate. WORKING CAPITAL: distributor funded by suppliers (trade and bills payables 4.9bn vs inventory 2.5bn + receivables 0.3bn); annual core WC inflow was 15% (FY2025) and 33% (FY2024) of the revenue increase; modelled at 10% base / 5% bear / 12% bull of the YoY revenue change (H1 is seasonally negative every year and is not a run-rate). SBC-ZERO does not apply: SBC is 1-1.7% of revenue, so house and street differ. SHARE COUNT held flat (SBC expensed). PENDING M&A: the Conti Trade Australia (mycar, ~280 stores) acquisition at EV ~A$403m (~RMB1.9bn) is pending regulatory approval and is assumed value-neutral (cash exchanged for an operating asset at fair value); it is not in the flows or the bridge -- if it closes and under-earns, up to ~HK$2.9/share of the net-cash leg is at risk. 'Purchase of treasury investments' (8bn gross) in investing cash flow is cash management, not buybacks.

bear.rationale: JD Auto Care / Tmall price war persists and China consumption stays flat: growth fades to 2.5% by FY2033, adjusted EBITDA margin stays at the H1 FY2026 trough (3.5%) and only drifts to 4.0%; capex held at 1.4% with no leverage; tax shelter rolls off to 20%; supplier float capture halves as growth slows.

base.rationale: FY2026 growth 10.5% (H1 +11.4%, H2 slower on subdued consumption and a high H2 FY2025 base), decelerating to 3.5% as store-count growth normalises. Adjusted EBITDA margin troughs at 3.9% in FY2026 (H1 3.7%, H2 FY2025 4.2%) and recovers only to the FY2023-24 level (5.0-5.3%) by FY2030, reaching 5.5% at maturity: store maturation, mix shift to franchise/advertising fees and procurement scale, offset by continued price concessions. Capex 1.4% -> 1.3% (FY2025 1.5%, H1 FY2026 1.2%). Cash tax ramps 6% -> 18%.

bull.rationale: Consolidation accelerates (policy support for scaled chains, 4S closures), NEV out-of-warranty servicing and lower-tier expansion sustain 10-12% growth to FY2029; price war eases and platform monetisation plus AI/automation lift adjusted EBITDA margin to 7.0%, ~1.4pp above the historical peak. Supplier float capture 12%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 30% from the 15% house default: the bear case's conditions (price war, flat China consumption, margin at the H1 FY2026 trough) are the live situation rather than a hypothetical, margins have fallen three years running against repeated management promises of restoration, and the controlling founder's WVR structure plus a pending A$403m overseas acquisition add capital-allocation risk to a thesis that is half net cash. Bull cut to 20% because it needs several independent things to go right -- a margin level never achieved, a durable easing of the price war and sustained double-digit growth. Base 50%.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.

diagnosis.detail: Structural risks in the qualitative analysis that a standard WACC may not price: cyclicality, regulatory single point of failure
